cast.title: Marvel Studios' 2021 Disney+ Day Special
cast.overview: Explore the Disney+ series of the MCU—past, present and future!

cast.title: Dear White People
cast.overview: A campus culture war between Blacks and whites at a predominantly white Ivy League college comes to a head when the staff of a satirical magazine stages an offensive Halloween party.

cast.title: How Do You Know
cast.overview: After being cut from the USA softball team and feeling a bit past her prime, Lisa finds herself evaluating her life and in the middle of a love triangle, as a corporate guy in crisis competes with her current, baseball-playing beau.

cast.title: A Picture of You
cast.overview: Kyle and Jen, estranged siblings, travel from New York City to rural Pennsylvania to pack up the home of their recently deceased mother. While there, they make a discovery that turns their world upside-down.  A Picture of You is a serious movie about life that gets sideswiped in the supermarket parking lot by a funny movie about death. It’s a story about family, loss, secrets, letting go, and starting anew.

cast.title: They Came Together
cast.overview: A small business owner is about to lose her shop to a major corporate development.

cast.title: Dashing Through the Snow
cast.overview: Eddie Garrick is a good-hearted man who has lost his belief in the wonder of Christmas. While spending time with his nine-year-old daughter Charlotte on Christmas Eve, he befriends a mysterious man in a red suit named Nick.

cast.title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of The Marvels
cast.original_title: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of The Marvels
cast.overview: Take an intergalactic trip with the cast and crew of "The Marvels" as they tell their experiences making this weird and wonderful film. Step into all the departments of production and discover how they created complex fight scenes, countless alien life forms, and some of the most elaborate sets ever. From dance parties to kitten days, the cast and crew had an unforgettable time making the movie.

cast.title: 90 Days
cast.overview: A riveting story of love, integrity and compassion, 90 DAYS explores a beautiful couple's relationship and their life altering decision after ninety days of dating. Fueled with gripping performances by an extraordinary cast of actors led by Teyonah Parris and Nic Few, 90 DAYS is a groundbreaking cinematic piece of art that confronts the human experience of overcoming one of life's greatest perceived challenges. Written by Nathan Hale Williams and directed by Williams and Jennia Fredrique Aponte, the film is entertaining, authentic and a visual masterpiece. 90 Days is a film that will touch hearts while navigating the definition of ultimate compassion.

cast.title: Chi-Raq
cast.overview: A modern day adaptation of the ancient Greek play Lysistrata by Aristophanes, set against the backdrop of gang violence in Chicago.

cast.title: Five Nights in Maine
cast.overview: A young African American man, reeling from the tragic loss of his wife, travels to rural Maine to seek answers from his estranged mother-in-law, who is herself confronting guilt and grief over her daughter's death.

cast.title: Where Children Play
cast.overview: A young woman is forced to nurse the father who abused her after her mother's death.

cast.title: Love Under New Management: The Miki Howard Story
cast.original_title: Love Under New Management: The Miki Howard Story
cast.overview: Story of Miki Howard, an American R&B and Jazz singer, whose hits include "Ain't Nobody Like You" and "Ain't Nuthin' in the World."

cast.title: If Beale Street Could Talk
cast.overview: After her fiance is falsely imprisoned, a pregnant African-American woman sets out to clear his name and prove his innocence.

cast.title: Point Blank
cast.overview: A nurse is forced to spring a wounded murder suspect from the hospital when the man’s brother kidnaps his pregnant wife and wants to make a trade.

cast.title: Charm City Kings
cast.overview: Mouse desperately wants to join The Midnight Clique, the infamous Baltimore dirt bike riders who rule the summertime streets. When Midnight’s leader, Blax, takes 14-year-old Mouse under his wing, Mouse soon finds himself torn between the straight-and-narrow and a road filled with fast money and violence.

cast.title: Candyman
cast.overview: A Chicago artist's sanity starts to unravel, unleashing a terrifying wave of violence when he begins to explore the macabre history of the Candyman.

cast.title: The Photograph
cast.overview: When famed photographer Christina Eames dies unexpectedly, she leaves her estranged daughter, Mae, hurt, angry and full of questions. When Mae finds a photograph tucked away in a safe-deposit box, she soon finds herself delving into her mother's early life -- an investigation that leads to an unexpected romance with a rising journalist.

cast.title: They Cloned Tyrone
cast.overview: A series of eerie events thrusts an unlikely trio onto the trail of a nefarious government conspiracy lurking directly beneath their neighborhood.

cast.title: The Marvels
cast.overview: When her duties send her to an anomalous wormhole linked to a Kree revolutionary, Carol's powers become entangled with that of Jersey City super-fan Kamala Khan, aka Ms. Marvel, and Carol's estranged niece, now S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau. Together, this unlikely trio must team up and learn to work in concert to save the universe.

cast.title: Marvel Studios: Expanding the Universe
cast.overview: An exciting look into the future of Marvel Studios' films and upcoming Disney+ series.

cast.title: Empire Corner
cast.overview: A woman travels across New York City -- and between two cultures -- as she looks for the man she never got a chance to know.

cast.title: Matchbox the Movie
cast.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

cast.title: Wu Is Dead
cast.overview: A ‘sequel’ to JP Chang’s short film Empire Corner.  Sun Mei tracks down those responsible for her brothers death.

cast.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Family Affair
cast.overview: When a family celebration brings relatives and friends together for a weekend, old secrets, unexpected relationships, and long-standing grudges quickly turn the gathering upside down. As tensions rise and drama unfolds, Madea steps in to set everyone straight before the family's biggest secret tears them apart.

cast.title: Turpentine
cast.overview: After her son hires friends to steal the family’s antique gun collection to pay off a debt, the mother steps in to clean up the mess, triggering a chain of events that stretches the family bond to its limit.

cast.title: Running
cast.overview: A homeless high school running prodigy hunts for greatness as he uses his gifts to outrun his past and find a family.

cast.title: Don't Go Gentle
cast.overview: A mother and honorary discharged army medic refuses to let a wrongful conviction become the final word on her life and ends up being pulled into the privileged but strained world of a former judge and his family.
